tiles.title: The Dragon Moon Gate
tiles.brief: The Dragon Moon Gate is an inhabited flight school. Sweep an ascending arcade into a jade loop around the dragon’s turn. Cut a spectators’ court through the thick lower arc. A vermilion dragon banking through the opening overlaps the near rim while its tail disappears behind the far one. Show handlers at the launch stair, harnesses hung in a shaded bay and a worn landing ledge. Design the broad base as a working precinct occupying the entire outlined footprint. Show the ground-facing edges in the same orientation as the guide. Keep the roof, wings and airborne subject within the tile width. Depict only objects belonging to this particular activity; the museum, observatory and kite yard inform the quality of drawing, not its inventory. Adults and doors are tiny in this large complex, with dozens of inhabited levels. Compose a steep bird’s-eye view with generous roof planes. Keep the whole illustration comfortably inside the canvas.
